dedupe_keys.name: review of french design maintenance and operation standards for transport infrastructure under climate change cerema dgitm

description: This Climate-ADAPT case study describes the systematic review of French technical standards and guidelines for the design, maintenance and operation of transport infrastructure that Cerema completed in 2015 for the Directorate General for Infrastructure, Transport and Sea (DGITM) of the Ministry of Ecology. A working group with experts for roads, bridges, earthworks, cableways, railways, aviation, waterways and ports, including CETU, STAC, STRMTG, RFF, SNCF and VNF, screened standards for climate elements such as temperature, flood, rain and wind and sorted them into three groups: no revision needed, revision needed, and more climate information needed before deciding. Some hundreds of standards were reviewed, more than 800 for roads alone, with examples such as road pavement design (to revise) and long welded rails (needing clearer climate parameters). The page, first published in 2016 and updated in 2026, is accessible online as free HTML with links to Cerema's pages. Caveats: no cost figures exist, since the work used the administration's own staff; the page describes the process up to 2016 and does not report which revised standards were adopted later; climate inputs were based on the SRES B2 and A2 scenarios of the 2015 national plan. The case illustrates climate adaptation of design standards for all transport modes, a step that sets the hazard thresholds used in resilience and exposure studies; related records are the UK railway drainage allowances and Slovak railway corridor case studies.
name: Review of French design, maintenance and operation standards for transport infrastructure under climate change (Cerema, DGITM)
outcomes: Standards were sorted into three groups by revision need; more than 800 road standards were reviewed and revision of the second group began, while the third awaited more precise climate parameters.
provider: Climate-ADAPT (European Environment Agency), case study from Cerema
resources_used: French National Climate Change Adaptation Plan 2015 projections (SRES B2 and A2)
